## Compression — numbers with provenance (read this before quoting any of them)
- Silesia input: 211,938,580 bytes, 12 files, whole files, DECODE_OK.
- TNSSRC 0.1.0: 43,724,575 bytes (about 43.72 million) on the official Silesia 12. That is the
  figure listed for TNSSRC 0.1.0 on Matt Mahoney's benchmark tables, and it is the only TNSSRC
  Silesia number we publish. All 12 files come back byte for byte. It beats xz-9. It is not a
  #1 claim.
- PCC: 51,498,645 bytes, 12/12, verified (not a #1 claim). pulsar 2.5.0: 55,745,438 bytes,
  12/12. champ: 50,541,135 bytes, 12/12. gzip-9: 67,631,990. bzip2-9: 54,506,769.
  xz-6 (about 49.4M) still beats PCC; TNSSRC beats both.
- Rules: never expand (a pathway that would expand stores RAW instead); decode restores
  every byte or the path refuses; live bench at /bench is a live 4 MiB-cap demo against
  gzip-9 and brotli-11, not the official Silesia board. Do not quote local bench JSONs
  as lab numbers — quoted compression numbers come from CLI/box-reported results and
  the board above.

### Compression · PCC
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pcc
- Demos: https://www.slidphilabs.com/demos
- pulsar 2.5.0 (public GPLv3): https://www.slidphilabs.com/pulsar
- Release: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/pulsar-best/releases/tag/v2.5.0
- Silesia 55,745,438 / 211,938,580 DECODE_OK 12/12. Beats gzip-9. Loses to bzip2 and xz. Matches OSCB. Free local binary.
- PCC on the same official 12: 51,498,645, DECODE_OK 12/12. champ 50,541,135 12/12. gzip-9 67,631,990. bzip2-9 54,506,769. xz-6 (about 49.4M) still beats PCC. Not a #1 claim.
- TNSSRC (local engine): Silesia 43,724,575, 12/12 back byte-identical. Beats xz-9.
- Board: https://www.slidphilabs.com/silesia · https://www.slidphilabs.com/blog/2026-09-09-silesia-pcc
- Meter $0.25/GB after 1 GB once per address · Pro $25/mo · $250/yr. Access, not source.

- PCC meter = first 1 GB free once per address (lifetime), then $0.25/GB. Pro is $25/mo with 100 GB, then $0.20/GB. Not a fifth product.
- Lab Pass = Chamber year + Rider Solo year + PSI Meter 1 seat + Warrant add-on year, $495/yr. Parts sum $650. PCC is out.
